description: The Autonomous Region of Friuli Venezia Giulia publishes building polygons extracted from its CTRN 5000 technical cartography, with associated heights and volumes. The reviewed inventory includes 75 first-edition metadata entries for 25 IGM 1:50,000 tiles and 57 second-edition entries for 19 tiles. The 19 second-edition tiles are a subset of the 25 first-edition tile identities, giving 25 distinct tiles across both editions. Each tile has download and map-service representations; the editions are versions of one building-stock resource. First-edition descriptions identify a GeoMedia Access database and second-edition descriptions a GIS database. Native distribution paths explicitly distinguish Ed1 from Ed2. Shapefile, KML/KMZ and GeoMedia Access distributions are listed, alongside WMS and WFS services. Public access is unrestricted, but public-data wording does not supply a specific reuse licence. Metadata dates are March 2008 for the first edition and June 2009 for the second; individual building observation dates remain unverified. Building dimensions can supply built-stock geometry for energy or exposure simulations. No files or features were downloaded, so accuracy, building use, materials and current completeness were not checked. Related regional transport and water inventories concern different assets.
